content: Rifampin reduces the plasma levels or therapeutic effects of fostamatinib by inducing hepatic and intestinal CYP3A4 enzyme metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider an alternative drug. Rifampin decreases the levels or efficacy of fruquintinib through its effect on CYP3A4-mediated metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative medication. Rifampin lowers the plasma concentration or therapeutic effect of futibatinib by enhancing CYP3A4 enzyme activity. Avoid coadministration or select an alternative drug. Coadministration of futibatinib with dual P-gp and strong CYP3A inducers may reduce its efficacy. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Rifampin diminishes the levels or effects of ganaxolone by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider an alternative drug. If coadministration is unavoidable, increase the ganaxolone dose cautiously without exceeding the maximum daily dose for weight. Rifampin reduces the plasma levels or therapeutic effects of gepirone by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifampin decreases the levels or efficacy of gilteritinib by mechanisms involving P-gp and CYP3A4 substrates. Avoid coadministration or consider an alternative drug. Coadministration with strong P-gp and CYP3A inducers reduces gilteritinib exposure and efficacy. Rifampin lowers the plasma concentration or therapeutic effect of glasdegib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of glecaprevir/pibrentasvir by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. Rifampin decreases the plasma levels or therapeutic effects of hydrocortisone by enhancing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider an alternative drug. Rifampin reduces the levels or efficacy of hydroxyprogesterone caproate by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifampin significantly decreases the plasma levels of ibrutinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider an alternative drug. Strong CYP3A inducers reduce ibrutinib plasma concentrations by approximately 10-fold. Rifampin diminishes the levels or effects of idelalisib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Strong CYP3A4 inducers significantly reduce systemic exposure to idelalisib. Rifampin reduces the plasma concentration or therapeutic effect of iloperidone by enhancing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider an alternative drug. Rifampin decreases the levels or efficacy of indinavir by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism and increasing its clearance. This combination is contraindicated. Rifampin increases the toxicity of isoniazid by enhancing its metabolism to hepatotoxic metabolites. Avoid coadministration or consider an alternative drug. Rifampin reduces the plasma levels or therapeutic effects of istradefylline by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inducers. Rifampin decreases the levels or efficacy of ivabradine by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider an alternative drug. Avoid coadministration with moderate CYP3A4 inducers. Rifampin significantly reduces the systemic exposure of ivacaftor by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Strong CYP3A4 inducers reduce ivacaftor exposure by approximately 9-fold. Rifampin lowers the plasma concentration or therapeutic effect of ivosidenib by enhancing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider an alternative drug. Strong CYP3A4 inducers reduce ivosidenib plasma concentrations. Rifampin diminishes the levels or effects of ixabepilone by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Rifampin reduces the plasma levels or therapeutic effects of ixazomib by enhancing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider an alternative drug. Strong inducers decrease ixazomib Cmax by 54% and AUC by 74%. Rifampin reduces the plasma levels or therapeutic effects of larotrectinib by enhancing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If coadministration is unavoidable, double the larotrectinib dose and resume the prior dose after discontinuing the CYP3A4 inducer for 3-5 half-lives.
